use_cases: Displaying product updates, new features, or changelog announcements to users
Showing maintenance windows or scheduled downtime notifications
Communicating important system messages or status alerts
Promoting limited-time offers or marketing campaigns
Dismissible notification strip for cookie consent or policy updates
ai_summary: A dismissible announcement banner component with optional link support, hover lift animation, and tooltip-enabled close button. Features a subtle gradient fade effect at the top. Used to communicate important messages, updates, or alerts to users in a clean, non-intrusive way. Props accept title, description, optional href for linked announcements, and onClose callback for dismiss functionality.
